controls.name: SHIFT
controls.about: Modifier. Held together with a pad or button it gives the alternate function. Held with REVERSE and REMAIN it latches.

controls.name: REMAIN
controls.about: Shows the data of the last pad while held; modifier for bus assignment and group edits; mode switch inside several screens (chromatic play mode, TR-REC, start-point lock).

controls.name: EXIT
controls.about: Back or cancel; four quick presses stop everything; with DEL deletes a bank, with COPY copies a bank, with a pad stops it.

controls.name: DEL
controls.about: Delete. Alone opens pad delete selection; also an erase modifier inside pattern recording and marker editing.

controls.name: COPY
controls.about: Copy. Alone starts a copy selection; modifier for group edits and bank copy.

controls.name: REC
controls.about: Start or stop sampling and pattern recording.

controls.name: RESAMPLE
controls.about: Resample; zero-cross snap in edit screens; overdub in the looper.

controls.name: RECORD SETTING
controls.about: Opens sampling and pattern-recording settings.

controls.name: PATTERN SELECT
controls.about: Switches between sample mode and the pattern sequencer.

controls.name: PATTERN EDIT
controls.about: Opens the pattern edit screen while the pattern sequencer is on.

controls.name: START/END
controls.about: Start, loop and end point editing; end snap while sampling.

controls.name: PITCH/SPEED
controls.about: Opens the pitch, speed, volume and pan screen for a sample.

controls.name: MARK
controls.about: Markers; also skip-back or looper depending on the MARK Function system setting.

controls.name: BPM SYNC
controls.about: Syncs the sample to the bank or project tempo.

controls.name: GATE
controls.about: Gate playback on or off.

controls.name: LOOP
controls.about: Loop on or off.

controls.name: REVERSE
controls.about: Reverse playback on or off; pad mute with SHIFT.

controls.name: ROLL
controls.about: Roll (repeat) playback.

controls.name: HOLD
controls.about: Keeps pads playing after release; selects the chain number in pattern chain; switches DJ mode and pad mode.

controls.name: BUS FX
controls.about: Switches the bus that the effect buttons control.

controls.name: EXT SOURCE
controls.about: External input on or off.

controls.name: SUB PAD
controls.about: Extra velocity-sensitive pad; tap tempo, pattern start/stop, sample select in TR-REC, preview.

controls.name: BANK A/F
controls.about: Bank button. Pressing again switches between the A-E and F-J bank of the same button (F-J blink).

controls.name: BANK B/G
controls.about: Bank button. Pressing again switches between the A-E and F-J bank of the same button (F-J blink).

controls.name: BANK C/H
controls.about: Bank button. Pressing again switches between the A-E and F-J bank of the same button (F-J blink).

controls.name: BANK D/I
controls.about: Bank button. Pressing again switches between the A-E and F-J bank of the same button (F-J blink).

controls.name: BANK E/J
controls.about: Bank button. Pressing again switches between the A-E and F-J bank of the same button (F-J blink).

controls.name: FILTER+DRIVE
controls.about: Effect button for BUS 1 or BUS 2 (MFX selects from the effect list).

controls.name: RESONATOR
controls.about: Effect button for BUS 1 or BUS 2 (MFX selects from the effect list).

controls.name: DELAY
controls.about: Effect button for BUS 1 or BUS 2 (MFX selects from the effect list).

controls.name: ISOLATOR
controls.about: Effect button for BUS 1 or BUS 2 (MFX selects from the effect list).

controls.name: DJFX LOOPER
controls.about: Effect button for BUS 1 or BUS 2 (MFX selects from the effect list).

controls.name: MFX
controls.about: Effect button for BUS 1 or BUS 2 (MFX selects from the effect list).

controls.name: CTRL1
controls.about: Control knob 1. Main parameter 1 of the current screen or effect.

controls.name: CTRL2
controls.about: Control knob 2.

controls.name: CTRL3
controls.about: Control knob 3. Also chooses SYSTEM and EFX SET tabs.

controls.name: VALUE
controls.about: Endless encoder with push. Turn selects or edits, press confirms. Also used as a held modifier.

controls.name: VOLUME
controls.about: Master output volume.

controls.name: INPUT GAIN
controls.about: Analog gain of the front INPUT jack (not the GAIN item of the SYSTEM menu).

controls.name: MIC/GUITAR
controls.about: Input impedance switch for the INPUT jack.

controls.name: POWER
controls.about: Power slide switch.

controls.name: PAD1
controls.about: Velocity-sensitive pad 1 of the 4x4 grid.

controls.name: PAD2
controls.about: Velocity-sensitive pad 2 of the 4x4 grid.
